name: Sakakibara Miho
source:
Gives off a more sexy and adult like feeling than Reina.

Possesses a mature disposition, unimaginable from a student. Has a very understanding character, finds being jealous unpleasant and dislikes the troublesome relationships between men and women.

Sexual curiosity is very unrestrained, due to which techniques are considerably polished.

Feels everything is transient and is not good at untiringly doing something.

She is avoided by the normal school boys but is suitable for the men, who have confidence in sex. She, herself enjoys that thrill.

Hobbies include all sports in general. Especially, she is addicted to snowboarding. Also loves to dance. She is very bad at studying.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/dz/sakasa_t/sakasa_t.html]website[/url]]
